instruction.text: This map shows the location of the grasslands around the world. What do you notice about their location?

b: They are only found in the Northern Hemisphere.

atoms.b: There are two types of grassland. The dark areas on the map show temperate ((++grasslands woodlands)), and the light areas show savannahs.

instruction.text: This is a temperate grassland. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: What feature of temperate grasslands do you notice in the image?
What type of climate do you think temperate grasslands have?
b: polar: extremely cold and snowy all year round

atoms.b: Savannahs have a tropical climate, which means the year is split into only two ((paragraphs ++seasons)): the wet season and the dry season.
Their vegetation consists of clumps of ((ice ++grass)) and some trees.

instruction.text: Drag the savannah onto Tanzania to find out more.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The Serengeti is an example of a savannah. It is located in Tanzania, a country in East Africa.
Here, a vast amount of wildlife can be found — the Serengeti is especially well known for its large population of lions! The Serengeti National Park is monitored and protected by specialists.

atoms.a: Which African country is the Serengeti located in?
What is the Serengeti known for?
b: its large population of polar bears

instruction.text: The animals in the savannah have adapted to their environment. Select the giraffe to find out more.

feedback.finish: Giraffes have long necks to help them reach and eat the leaves on tall trees, which means they don’t have to share the grass with other plant-eating animals.
